sourceType: Official Government of Punjab tourism website
note: Facts extracted below; prose summaries are written in our own words, not copied verbatim from the source.
about: Named after Sahibzada Ajit Singh, Guru Gobind Singh Ji's eldest son. Punjab's 18th district (2006), carved from Rupnagar and Patiala. Part of the Chandigarh Tricity; a major IT hub.

places.name: Fateh Burj, Chappar Chiri
places.location: Chappar Chiri village, on Banda Singh Bahadur Road, just outside Mohali
places.facts: Tallest victory tower in India, 100m, completed 2011, French-Sikh architectural style; commemorates Banda Singh Bahadur's 1710 victory over Wazir Khan of Sirhind. Also called Baba Banda Singh Bahadur Memorial.

places.name: Gurdwara Sri Amb Sahib
places.timings: Open daily; Amrit Sanchar every Sangrand 10am
places.facts: Site where Guru Har Rai Sahib Ji fulfilled Guru Arjan Dev Ji's promise to eat a mango from Bhai Kurma Ji's hand.

places.name: Gurdwara Singh Shaheedan, Sohana
places.facts: Preserves artefacts related to Sikh martyrs.

places.name: Punjab Cricket Association (PCA) IS Bindra Stadium
places.facts: Home ground of Punjab Kings IPL team; hosts international matches.

places.name: M.C. Zoological Park, Chhatbir
places.facts: Zoo with a wide range of flora and fauna.

howToReach.note: Contiguous with Chandigarh; part of the Chandigarh Tricity.
